_about: The Help window's tutorial: each shot is a real screenshot of the app with numbered arrows to its buttons, and the list under it says what each does. tools/help-shots/shoot.mjs takes the screenshots from the running desk (http://localhost:8940/) and writes them into help.html between the TOUR markers. When a feature is added, add its callout here and run: node tools/help-shots/shoot.mjs. scripts/check.py fails if a top-bar, toolbar or dock button has no callout. 'dock: true' builds its callouts from the dock itself, with each button's text taken from help.html (its <dt>). 'who': owner = only on James's desk, public = only on jayms.com.

shots.title: The top bar
shots.intro: Along the top, left to right.

callouts.name: Plan
callouts.text: Shows or hides the reading plan on the left (on a phone it slides in).

callouts.name: jayms.com
callouts.text: Opens the online version of the app on jayms.com.

callouts.name: Bible Study / Hebrew & Greek / Atlas
callouts.text: Switches between the three. Hebrew & Greek reads John, Genesis and Psalms with the places the original shapes the English marked. Atlas is the map on its own.

callouts.name: Atlas
callouts.text: The map full size with no reader, and a search: a place, a journey, a kingdom, or a topic like the Ark (where it went, and every place it is claimed to be today, with the case for and against). Opening a verse goes back to Bible Study at that passage.

callouts.name: Classes
callouts.text: Your online classes (Peterson Academy, BibleProject Classroom, AWKNG): a lesson plays in its own window on the right half of the screen, you tick it Done and keep notes here, and a semester plan lays the lessons left in every class onto the days you choose.

callouts.name: Learn
callouts.text: Packs to learn from, read in place from your vault. The first is Reading Greek Deeply: every lesson, with each Greek word's lemma beside it (click a word and it says its lemma), a paradigm opened from any code, vocabulary and paradigm drills, and a review of what you have finished.

callouts.name: My desk / Read along
callouts.text: My desk is your full view. Read along shows what a visitor sees.

callouts.name: Settings
callouts.text: Turns Logos links and verse numbers on or off.

callouts.name: About
callouts.text: Why this app exists.

callouts.name: Donate
callouts.text: Buy Me a Coffee, to support the project.

callouts.name: Help
callouts.text: This guide, plus the buttons to report a bug or ask for a feature.

shots.title: The reading plan
shots.intro: The left side: which plan you're reading and where you are in it.

callouts.name: Reading plan
callouts.text: Tap to pick a plan. Each app lists its own plans.

callouts.name: The Bible
callouts.text: Go to any book, chapter and verse without changing your plan.

callouts.name: Matching psalm
callouts.text: Adds a psalm that matches the day's reading.

callouts.name: Hide genealogies & lists
callouts.text: Genealogy and list chapters are greyed in the list; this takes them out.

callouts.name: Progress
callouts.text: Which day of the plan it is, and how much is done.

callouts.name: Restart this plan
callouts.text: Clears this plan's Done ticks and starts it again from day 1, today. It asks first, and your other plans are not touched.

callouts.name: A day
callouts.text: Tap a day to read it. The list starts at the first day not yet done.

callouts.name: Done tick
callouts.text: Ticks itself when every reading that day is marked Done.

callouts.name: Show all
callouts.text: Long plans show the next seven days; this opens the rest.

shots.title: The reader
shots.intro: The middle: the passage, and how it's shown.

callouts.name: Reading tabs
callouts.text: One tab for each of the day's readings, and one for each passage you open with Go. × closes an opened passage.

callouts.name: Go to a passage
callouts.text: Type any reference, like Mark 13:14 or Psalm 82, and press Go. It opens in its own tab beside the day's readings.

callouts.name: Find in the text
callouts.text: Highlights a word everywhere in the passage on screen. Enter jumps to the next one. It sits beside Go to a passage; in a narrow window it folds to a search button.

callouts.name: Open in Logos
callouts.text: Opens the passage in your Logos app.

callouts.name: Verses / Reading
callouts.text: Named for what it switches to: one verse per line, or paragraphs.

callouts.name: Parallel / Single
callouts.text: Shows two versions side by side, paragraph by paragraph.

callouts.name: Hide # / Show #
callouts.text: Takes the verse numbers off the page or puts them back (also in Settings).

callouts.name: Version
callouts.text: Which translation you read in: LSB, ESV, NET, NLT, NASB, CSB, BSB, KJV, MSG or Brenton's Septuagint.

callouts.name: A− and A+
callouts.text: Makes the text smaller or bigger.

callouts.name: Voice
callouts.text: Speechify voice and speed for Read. It shows once you have pasted your own Speechify key in Settings.
Previous and next chapter.

callouts.name: FC
callouts.text: Full chapter: in place of « » when only part of a chapter is on screen, with a breadcrumb back to the verses you were on.

callouts.name: Verse number
callouts.text: Tap a verse number for that verse's tools.

callouts.name: Highlight and Read
callouts.text: Highlight marks a column and copies it; Read reads it aloud with Speechify (once your own key is in Settings).

shots.title: Under the text
shots.intro: When you've read it. On jayms.com, James's public notes on the passage show under the text when he has written some, and the readings you mark Done are kept in your own browser on that device, so nobody else sees them.

callouts.name: Done
callouts.text: Marks this reading done; the day ticks when all its readings are.

callouts.name: Next →
callouts.text: The next reading of the day.

callouts.name: My notes
callouts.text: Your note on this passage. It saves to your notes and can open in Obsidian.

callouts.name: Public
callouts.text: Lets visitors on jayms.com read this note.

callouts.name: Save note
callouts.text: Saves the note (Cmd+S works too).

callouts.name: Close
callouts.text: Folds the notes bar down to its header, or brings it back. Drag its top edge to make it taller or shorter.

shots.title: The side buttons
shots.intro: Down the right edge (along the bottom on a phone). Each opens a panel about the passage on screen. A number is how many there are for this passage, a greyed button has nothing for it, and a plain one always has something.

shots.title: A panel
shots.intro: What opens when you tap a side button.

callouts.name: Heading
callouts.text: What the panel is showing, for which passage.
Closes the panel. Tapping the same side button closes it too.

callouts.name: Edge
callouts.text: Drag the panel's edge to make it wider or narrower; double-click puts it back.

callouts.name: Boxes
callouts.text: Each box's coloured edge says what it is: gold is Scripture, green is an ancient witness, olive is a reading of it, blue is an open question.

shots.title: Hebrew & Greek
shots.intro: The same frame, reading John, Genesis or Psalms with the places the original shapes the English marked.

callouts.name: Hebrew & Greek
callouts.text: Switches to this app; Bible Study switches back. Each remembers its own plan.

callouts.name: A marked word
callouts.text: An underlined word is a place the English Bibles part company. Red changes the claim, gold the emphasis, grey is cosmetic.

callouts.name: The original word
callouts.text: The Hebrew or Greek word, in English letters, right after the word it explains. Hover either and both light up; tap to open it.

callouts.name: Marks to show
callouts.text: Under the plan: Original words shows or hides the tags; the colour boxes turn each kind of mark on or off.

callouts.name: Marks
callouts.text: The panel for the mark you tapped: the versions around it, then plain English, what you're seeing, why translators split and the rule to carry away. ‹ › or the arrow keys step through the chapter's marks.
Steps to the previous or next mark in the chapter (the arrow keys do too).

callouts.name: Menu
callouts.text: The round button: the reading plan, The Bible, the three apps, Settings, About, Donate and Help.

callouts.name: Side buttons
callouts.text: Along the bottom; swipe sideways for more. A panel opens as a sheet over the text.
